verdicts.rationale: Clean reproduction confirmed: POST /entities/search on collection 'test_unloaded' succeeded with HTTP 200 and returned results, despite the collection never being loaded via /collections/load. Source code analysis (handler_v2.go:1487-1676) shows the search handler performs NO load state validation before proxy.Search() call - it only validates collection schema exists. Contract documentation states collections must be 'loaded into memory for searching and queries' (collections+load endpoint description), but API violates this contract. This is a Type1_IllegalSuccess defect matching REST_v2_data_type_handling shape - REST v2 fails to enforce core invariants that gRPC path validates.
